connection.insecure: This connection is not encrypted. Anyone on the same network can read what you send, including your password.

errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

request.invalid: The request was not valid. Check what you entered and try again.
request.precondition_required: This change needs the version of the item you were looking at. Reload and try again.
request.version_conflict: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload to see the current state, then try again.

resource.not_found: That item does not exist or is no longer available.

auth.invalid_credentials: The name, password or code is not correct.
auth.invalid_challenge: Signing in took too long. Start again.
auth.invalid_refresh_token: You have been signed out. Sign in again.
auth.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {retryAfterSeconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
auth.invalid_link_code: This code is no longer valid. Show a new QR code and scan it again.
auth.wrong_password: The current password is not correct.
auth.invalid_code: That code is not correct. Check the time on your phone and try the next code.

user.invalid_name: A name has {minLength} to {maxLength} letters or digits, and may contain dots, dashes and underscores.
user.name_taken: That name is already in use.
user.invalid_display_name: Enter a display name of up to 128 characters.
user.weak_password: A password has at least {minLength} characters.
user.last_admin: This is the only active admin. Make someone else an admin first.
user.deletion_scheduled: This account is scheduled for deletion. Cancel the deletion first.
user.deletion_not_scheduled: This account is not scheduled for deletion.
user.confirmation_mismatch: Type the account's name exactly to confirm.
user.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.

setup.already_done: This server already has an admin. Sign in instead.
setup.token_required: Enter the setup token from the server log.
setup.token_invalid: That setup token is not correct. It changes every time the server starts; copy the newest one from the log.
setup.storage_missing: Add a storage location before finishing.

storage.invalid_config: Some of the storage settings are missing or not valid.
storage.root_missing: That folder does not exist. If it is a network share or an external disk, check that it is connected.
storage.path_not_allowed: Files cannot be stored in the folder where the server keeps its own data. Choose another folder.
storage.location_in_use: This location already holds data from an Atrium server and cannot be added as new.
storage.name_taken: Another storage location already has that name.
storage.identity_missing: This location is reachable but empty. If it is a network share or an external disk, it is probably not connected.
storage.identity_mismatch: A different storage location was found in this place.
storage.unavailable: The storage location could not be reached.
storage.access_denied: The server is not allowed to read or write there. Check the permissions or the access keys.
storage.bucket_not_found: That bucket does not exist. Check the name.
storage.read_back_mismatch: The location returned different data than was written to it. It cannot be trusted with files.

job.not_retryable: Only a task that failed or was cancelled can be tried again.
job.already_queued: The same task is already waiting or running.
job.unexpected_error: The task stopped because of an unexpected error.
job.unknown_type: This server does not know how to run this task. It may come from a newer version.
job.lease_lost: The task was interrupted and will be started again.

files.no_storage: This server has no storage location yet. An admin has to add one before files can be stored.
files.quota_exceeded: There is not enough space left in your storage quota.

navigation.invalid_layout: This menu arrangement could not be saved. Reload and try again.
navigation.too_many_views: You can keep at most {max} views. Remove one first.
navigation.invalid_view: Give the view a name and check its rules.

album.invalid_name: Give the album a name of at most 255 characters.
album.not_in_album: The cover has to be one of the album's photos.

media.unsupported: This file cannot be shown as a picture on this server.
media.tool_missing: The server is missing a tool for photos and videos. The administrator can find out more in the log.
media.no_thumbnail: There is no preview of this file.

library.invalid_name: Give the library a name of at most 128 characters.
library.path_not_absolute: Enter the full path of the folder on the server, for example /mnt/storage/archive.
library.path_missing: There is no folder at this path on the server. With Docker, the folder has to be mounted into the container first.
library.path_unreadable: The server cannot read this folder. Check its permissions.
library.path_protected: This folder is, contains or lies inside Atrium's own data. Choose another folder.
library.path_overlaps: This folder is, contains or lies inside another library's folder. A file can belong to only one library.
library.not_external: Only a library that points at an existing folder can be removed this way.
library.confirmation_mismatch: Type the library's name exactly as shown to confirm.
library.unknown_user: One of the chosen people no longer exists. Reload and try again.
library.folder_unavailable: The folder cannot be reached. If it is on a network share or an external disk, check that it is mounted.
library.folder_empty: The folder is suddenly empty. If it is on a network share or an external disk, check that it is mounted.
library.too_many_missing: Most of the files disappeared at once, so nothing was removed from the library. Check that the folder is mounted, then scan again.
library.folder_read_only: Atrium cannot write to this folder. With Docker, remove :ro from the folder's mount and check its permissions.

node.invalid_name: That name cannot be used. Names cannot contain / or \, end with a dot or a space, or be a reserved name such as CON.
node.name_conflict: Something with that name is already in this folder.
node.not_a_folder: This is a file, not a folder.
node.not_a_file: This is a folder, not a file.
node.move_into_itself: A folder cannot be moved or copied into itself.
node.read_only: You can look at this, but not change it.
node.in_trash: This item is in the trash. Restore it first.
node.not_in_trash: This item is not in the trash.
node.is_root: The top folder of a library cannot be changed.
node.cross_library: Items cannot be moved between libraries.
node.too_many_items: This folder holds too many items to copy at once (more than {max}).
node.not_supported: This cannot be done in a library that shows an existing folder.

upload.offset_mismatch: The upload got out of step with the server. It continues from where the server stopped.
upload.checksum_mismatch: Part of the file was damaged on the way. It is sent again.
upload.content_mismatch: The file that arrived is not the file that was sent, so it was not saved.
upload.invalid_chunk_size: The upload was sent in pieces the server cannot accept.
upload.too_large: This file is too large to upload.
upload.not_active: This upload has already finished or was cancelled.
upload.busy: This upload is already being sent from somewhere else.
upload.expired: This upload was not continued for a day and was discarded. Start it again.
upload.unsupported_version: This app uses an upload protocol the server does not support. Update the app.
upload.invalid_metadata: The upload is missing its folder or name.

files.title: Files
files.readOnlyFolder: This folder is shown as it is on the server; nothing in it can be changed here. An administrator can allow changes.
files.readOnlyFolderAdmin: This folder is shown as it is on the server; nothing in it can be changed here yet. You can allow changes and choose who makes them under Libraries.
files.readOnlyNotWriter: Changes are allowed in this folder, but not for you. An administrator can let you change files under Libraries.
files.firstReading: This folder is still being read for the first time; its files appear here as they are found.
files.noLibrary: There is nowhere to store files yet. An admin has to add a storage location first.
files.selected: {count, plural, one {# item selected} other {# items selected}}
files.count: {count, plural, =0 {No items} one {# item} other {# items}}
files.movedToTrash: {count, plural, one {# item moved to the trash.} other {# items moved to the trash.}}
files.emptyWritable: This folder is empty. Drop files here or use Upload files.
files.dropHere: Drop to upload into this folder
files.name: Name
files.moveTo: {count, plural, one {Move # item to…} other {Move # items to…}}
files.copyTo: {count, plural, one {Copy # item to…} other {Copy # items to…}}
files.noVersions: No earlier versions. Replacing this file keeps its current content here.
files.deleteVersionConfirm: Remove this earlier version? Its content cannot be recovered afterwards.

trash.title: Trash
trash.lead: Deleted items stay here for 30 days and still count toward your storage.
trash.folderInTrash: This folder is in the trash too
trash.daysLeft: {count, plural, =0 {removed today} one {removed in # day} other {removed in # days}}
trash.confirm: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} ({size}) will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.conflictBody: Something called “{name}” is already in this folder.
uploads.replaceHelp: Replacing keeps the current file as an earlier version, so nothing is lost.
uploads.applyToAll: Do the same for the rest of this upload

welcome.heading: Welcome to Atrium
welcome.body: A few steps and your private cloud is ready. Your files stay on storage you control.
welcome.tokenHelp: To make sure it is you setting up this server, it printed a setup token to its log when it started. On the server, run {command} and copy the token here.

admin.heading: Create the admin account
admin.body: This account manages the server. You can add more people later.
admin.name: Name
admin.nameHelp: You sign in with this. Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
admin.passwordHelp: At least {minLength} characters. A sentence you can remember works well.
admin.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

storage.heading: Where should files be stored?
storage.body: Choose the place that will hold everyone's files. You can add more locations later.
storage.name: Name of this location
storage.pathHelp: The full path as the server sees it. In Docker this is a path inside the container, for example {example}.
storage.createDirectory: Create the folder if it does not exist
storage.willCreate: This folder does not exist yet. It will be created when you continue.
storage.shareNote: A network share must be mounted before the server starts. If it is ever missing, Atrium marks the location as offline and does not write anywhere else.
storage.serviceUrlHelp: Leave empty for Amazon S3. For other services enter their address, for example {example}.
storage.forcePathStyle: Address the bucket in the path (needed by most self-hosted services)
storage.holdsData: This location already holds data from an Atrium server and cannot be added as new.
storage.formatNote: Files are stored in Atrium's own layout and named by their content. Their names and folders are kept in the server's database. Back up the server's config folder together with this location so that both can be restored.
storage.kindLocalHelp: A disk inside this machine or attached to it.
storage.kindShareHelp: A NAS or a shared folder of another computer.
storage.kindS3Help: Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, MinIO and similar.

access.heading: Reaching Atrium
access.outside: To use Atrium away from home, put it behind HTTPS. There are three ways:
access.optionCaddy: Turn on the built-in HTTPS service in the Compose file, if you have a domain name.
access.optionProxy: Use a reverse proxy you already run.
access.optionTunnel: Use a tunnel service, with no ports opened on your router.
access.later: You can do this later. Nothing here is required to finish.

done.heading: Atrium is ready
done.body: The server is set up and storage is working.
done.phoneBody: Open the Atrium app and scan this code. It signs the phone in to your account. The code works once and for two minutes.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.name: Name
signIn.totpBody: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
signIn.body: Use the name and password of your Atrium account.

devices.heading: Devices
devices.body: Every device signed in to your account. Sign out any you do not recognize.

phone.heading: Connect a phone
phone.body: Open the Atrium app on the phone and scan the code. No password is typed on the phone.
phone.validFor: Valid for {seconds, plural, one {# more second} other {# more seconds}}.
phone.codeLabel: QR code for connecting a phone

approve.heading: Approve a device
approve.body: A TV or another device without a keyboard shows a code. Enter it here.
approve.found: {device} wants to sign in to your account.
approve.warning: Approve only if this device is in front of you and shows this code.
approve.readOnly: Read-only: it cannot change or delete anything
approve.hidePersonal: Hide my personal files on this device
approve.approved: Approved. The device is signing in.
approve.denied: Denied. The device was not signed in.
approve.notFound: No device is waiting with that code. Codes expire after ten minutes.

account.heading: Account
account.resetNotice: An administrator reset your password. Choose a new one that only you know.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
account.body: Your profile and how you sign in.

totp.heading: Two-step verification
totp.off: Off. Signing in asks only for your password.
totp.on: On. Signing in also asks for a code from your authenticator app.
totp.scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code the app shows.
totp.manual: Or type this key into the app:
totp.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.recoveryBody: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now, so keep them somewhere safe.
totp.disableBody: Enter your password to turn off two-step verification.

brand.subline: Files, photos and video on storage you control.
brand.pointOwn: Your data never leaves your server
brand.pointApps: Web, phone and TV on one account

people.heading: People
people.body: Everyone who can sign in to this server. You manage their accounts and never see their files.
people.name: Name
people.disableConfirm: Disable {name}? They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until enabled again.
people.resetHelp: They are signed out everywhere and told that an administrator reset their password.
people.resetDone: Password reset. Give {name} the new password.

storageAdmin.heading: Storage
storageAdmin.body: The places where files are kept.

photos.title: Photos
photos.empty: No photos or videos yet. Upload some in Files, or ask an administrator to add an existing folder.
photos.trashed: {count, plural, one {# item moved} other {# items moved}} to the trash.
photos.monthCount: {count, plural, one {# photo or video} other {# photos and videos}}

albums.title: Albums
albums.empty: No albums yet. Select photos in the timeline and add them to a new album.
albums.emptyAlbum: This album is empty. Add photos from the timeline.
albums.addTitle: Add {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to an album
albums.orExisting: Or add to an existing album:
albums.added: {count, plural, one {# item added} other {# items added}} to {name}.
albums.deleteBody: Only the album is deleted. Its photos and videos stay where they are.

search.title: Search
search.label: Search names, types and dates
search.hint: Type part of a name, a year or a month and year. Choose a type to see all of that kind.

admin.title: Administration
admin.lead: This server at a glance: what needs you first, then each part of it.

attention.storage_offline: The storage location {name} cannot be reached. Files on it cannot be opened until it is back.
attention.library_offline: The folder {name} is offline: it is missing, empty or unreadable. Nothing in it was removed.
attention.jobs_failed: {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}} failed in the last day.
attention.backup_none: There is no backup of the database yet.
attention.backup_old: The last backup is more than two days old.
attention.integrity_problems: The storage check found {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} missing or damaged.
attention.integrity_none: Storage has not been checked yet.
attention.integrity_old: Storage has not been checked for more than two weeks.
attention.people_deletion: {count, plural, one {# account is} other {# accounts are}} waiting to be deleted.

backups.lead: Copies of the database and checks of the stored files.
backups.heading: Backups
backups.what: Every day Atrium copies its database: names, folders, people and settings. The files themselves stay on their storage locations and are not part of it.
backups.failed: The backup failed. Background work shows why.
backups.restore: Restoring a backup is done from the command line for now; the backup guide explains how.

integrity.heading: Storage check
integrity.what: Once a week Atrium reads every stored file and compares it with what it should be, so damage is found while a backup can still help.
integrity.clean: Every file is where it should be and unchanged.
integrity.explainProblems: Some files are missing or damaged. Nothing was changed; restore them from a copy of the storage location if you have one.

menu.title: Customize menu
menu.lead: Choose what your menu shows and in what order, give entries your own names, and group them. This changes only your menu, never a file.
menu.entriesLead: Click a name to change it. Drag an entry to move it, or into a group to put it there; the arrows and the group list do the same from the keyboard.
menu.renameHint: Type to change the name; leave it empty for the usual one
menu.pinHint: To add a folder or an album, open it and choose Pin to menu.
menu.openSettingsLead: Order, names, icons, groups, views and the menu's size.
menu.resetDone: Your menu is back to the default.
menu.makeDefault: Make this the default for everyone
menu.defaultDone: This arrangement is now the default for everyone who has not arranged their own. Views stay personal.

views.title: Views
views.explain: A view is an entry in your menu that shows every file matching your rules, wherever it is, including files added later. It never moves or changes a file.
views.deleteBody: Only the view is deleted. The files it showed stay where they are.
views.empty: No files match this view yet.
views.name: Name
views.wordsHelp: Every word must appear in the file name; case and diacritics do not matter.
views.extensionsHelp: Separated by commas; any of them matches. Leave empty for all.
views.librariesHelp: None chosen means everywhere you can see.
views.whenHelp: Photos and videos by when they were taken, other files by when they were last changed.
views.matching: {count, plural, =0 {No files} one {# file} other {# files}}

libraries.heading: Libraries
libraries.body: Folders that already exist on the server, shown in Atrium as they are, with every file and subfolder in them.
libraries.people: {count, plural, =0 {nobody has access} one {# person has access} other {# people have access}}
libraries.addNote: Atrium reads this folder as it is and copies nothing. Every file and subfolder appears in Files for the people you choose. Until you allow changes, Atrium never creates, renames, changes or deletes anything in it.
libraries.added: The folder was added and is being read. Open it from the menu under Files.
libraries.name: Name
libraries.pathHelp: The full path as the server sees it. With Docker, mount the folder into the container first, read-only (:ro) unless you will allow changes.
libraries.pathOk: The folder can be read. {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} directly inside it.
libraries.removeBody: Atrium forgets this library: it leaves Files, the timeline and every album. The folder and every file in it stay exactly as they are.
libraries.whoChangesOff: Takes effect once changes are allowed for this library.
libraries.whoChangesOn: These people can rename, move, delete and upload in this folder.
libraries.enableWarning: Atrium will change the original files in {path}. Other programs that use this folder will see every change.
libraries.enableRename: Renaming and moving here renames and moves the files in the folder.
libraries.enableDelete: Deleting moves a file into the folder .atrium-trash inside this folder, and it is removed for good after 30 days.
libraries.enableUpload: Uploads are written into the folder.
libraries.enableOff: You can stop changes at any time; nothing is changed after that, not even the trash.
libraries.showInTimeline: Show its photos and videos in the timeline
libraries.showInTimelineHelp: All files are in Files either way. Turn this off for folders of documents or backups whose pictures should not mix with your photos.
libraries.writers: {count, plural, =0 {nobody may change files} one {# person may change files} other {# people may change files}}
libraries.nobodyWrites: Changes are allowed, but nobody is chosen to make them, so the folder is still read-only for everyone. Choose people under Access.
libraries.notForYou: You do not see this folder yourself. Add yourself under Access to open it.
libraries.nobodySees: Nobody sees this folder yet. Choose people under Access first.

backgroundWork.heading: Background work
backgroundWork.body: Thumbnails, scans and housekeeping run in the background. Here you choose how much of this machine they may use.
backgroundWork.machineFacts: {cores, plural, one {# core} other {# cores}}, {memory} of memory
backgroundWork.pausedOpen: Background work is paused until you resume it.
backgroundWork.pausedBusy: Background work is paused while the server is busy with work someone is waiting for.
backgroundWork.pauseNote: Work you start yourself, such as uploads, keeps running. Paused jobs continue where they stopped.
backgroundWork.limitsNote: The defaults suit this machine. A higher number finishes sooner but leaves less room for everything else.
